description: This file implements microphone handling for UWP platform using Microsoft's audio APIs, including device enumeration, audio capture, and data processing into PCM format.

classes.name: MutedTrigger
classes.description: Detects if the microphone has been muted for a specified duration.

classes.name: MicrophoneProcessor
classes.description: Encapsulates Microsoft's audio API for capturing and processing microphone input, mixing multiple microphones into PCM data.

classes.name: MicrophoneImpl
classes.description: Implements the SbMicrophonePrivate interface, managing microphone lifecycle and data reading.

methods.name: TryCreateAndStartRecording
methods.description: Creates and starts microphone processing if available.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads PCM audio data from the microphone buffer.
